libraries.name: @cosyte/hl7
libraries.description: Developer-focused HL7 v2 toolkit for Node.js and TypeScript, message parsing and building, mutation and serialization, and one-line helpers.

libraries.name: @cosyte/mllp
libraries.description: MLLP transport for HL7 v2 in Node.js and TypeScript: client and server, framing, ACK correlation, auto-reconnect, TLS, and an in-memory transport for tests.

libraries.name: @cosyte/fhir
libraries.description: FHIR R4 for Node.js and TypeScript: a resource model that keeps every value exactly as written, JSON and XML codecs, layered validation, and a safety readout for status and negation.

libraries.name: @cosyte/ccda
libraries.description: C-CDA parser, serializer, and builder for Node.js and TypeScript: lenient on parse, spec-clean on emit.

libraries.name: @cosyte/x12
libraries.description: Developer-focused ASC X12 healthcare EDI parser, serializer, and builder for Node.js and TypeScript: lenient on parse, spec-clean on emit.

libraries.name: @cosyte/ncpdp
libraries.description: NCPDP parser, serializer, and builder for Node.js and TypeScript: SCRIPT ePrescribing and Telecom pharmacy claims, lenient on parse, spec-clean on emit.

libraries.name: @cosyte/astm
libraries.description: ASTM parser, serializer, and builder for Node.js and TypeScript: lenient on parse, spec-clean on emit.

libraries.name: @cosyte/dicom
libraries.description: DICOM Part 10 parser + utility library for Node.js and TypeScript: metadata-first, vendor-quirky-tolerant, dual ESM/CJS.

libraries.name: @cosyte/terminology
libraries.description: Terminology engine for US healthcare code systems in Node.js and TypeScript: FHIR $translate, $lookup, $validate-code, and $expand over code systems, value sets, and maps you supply.

libraries.name: @cosyte/transform
libraries.description: HL7 v2 → FHIR R4 transformation library for Node.js and TypeScript: IG-grounded, fail-safe, value-free diagnostics; never a confident wrong FHIR value.

libraries.name: @cosyte/deid
libraries.description: Healthcare de-identification for Node.js and TypeScript: applies a HIPAA Safe Harbor policy to HL7 v2, C-CDA, FHIR R4, X12, NCPDP Telecom, and DICOM, fails closed, and emits a value-free manifest.

libraries.name: @cosyte/synth
libraries.description: Deterministic, seedable synthetic healthcare test fixtures for Node.js and TypeScript: HL7 v2, FHIR R4 and US Core, C-CDA, X12, NCPDP, and ASTM, spec-clean by construction and never real PHI.

libraries.name: @cosyte/dates
libraries.description: Date and time utilities for the @cosyte/* healthcare parsers: precision-preserving conversion and validation that never guesses a timezone.

libraries.name: @cosyte/cli
libraries.description: The Cosyte command line for Node.js and TypeScript: one command over HL7 v2, FHIR R4, X12, ASTM, NCPDP, C-CDA, DICOM, and MLLP, with HL7 v2 to FHIR conversion from transform, code mapping from terminology, and the cosyte-mcp MCP server for agents. Value-free diagnostics and a documented exit-code contract.

engine.name: @cosyte/pathways
engine.description: A code-first healthcare integration engine for Node.js: channels in YAML, transforms in TypeScript. Early and not yet released.
